exposure: Maternally inherited 7q31.1 microdeletions affecting the IMMP2L gene
outcome: DNA methylation levels of IMMP2L gene
cohort: The study included 3 families with maternally inherited 7q31.1 microdeletions affecting the IMMP2L gene, comprising probands, their healthy siblings and fathers, and healthy mothers.
finding: Healthy mothers with IMMP2L deletions showed reduced DNA methylation and increased IMMP2L expression compared to probands, suggesting a compensatory mechanism for haploinsufficiency that may explain incomplete penetrance of the microdeletion.
